utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time on Saturday do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mina. Could you come by at 10 a.m. so we can get set up before people arrive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m setting up the repair drive on the front porch this Saturday, and I could really use a couple of hands. Can you help?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. I can help out if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Pia. Could you come by at 10 on Saturday, and just bring a screwdriver if you have one?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: 10 should work for me, and I can bring a screwdriver. Just let me know what task you want me on when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m organizing the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, and I could use a few helpers if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Sam. I’m still looking for a few more helpers for the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still looking for a few helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good, I can help out then. Just let me know what time you want me there on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Uli. Let’s meet at the front porch this Saturday morning, and I’ll send you the exact time soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll be there on the front porch Saturday morning and will wait for your time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam. I’m still lining up the timing and task list, so once I have the schedule set I’ll send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Pia. Just send it over when it’s set, and I’ll be ready to help on Saturday.
